details.publicNotes:
Cabyar are large rodents whose long and brittle fur is interspersed with tiny specks of magical light. Naturally gifted at manipulating magical energies, these gentle creatures gather in large families in the margins of creeks or small lakes, preferring locations secluded from potential predators. They guard their homes by befriending the local wildlife, using magic when more mundane means fail.

When travelers arrive in their forested homes, cabyars regard them with caution, bending light to hide their bodies while observing the newcomers to discern their intentions. If the newcomers are peaceful, the cabyars are likely to invite them to play, particularly if the newcomers are accompanied by animal friends of their own. For those who prove entertaining, the cabyars might share their knowledge of the forest, from high-quality foraging spots to dangers best avoided. Though cabyars are quite well-informed about their surroundings, they can only communicate with animals, so their insights are often communicated in gestures or paraphrased through an animal's perspective.

However, if the newcomers instead bring harm to any of the cabyar's companions, the cabyar mobilizes the rest of their animal allies to drive them off, using lethal force if necessary. There is no shortage of would-be cabyar hunters with tales of approaching a cabyar's pond, only to be thwarted by the pounce of a large feline.

Dangerous Game

A cabyar's pelt can be used as an ingredient in the recipes for several magical items—but while cabyar hunting is not uncommon, the market for its products is limited. Good-hearted buyers generally don't want anything to do with hunting such gentle and helpful creatures, while less ethical buyers understand the danger of walking around the forest wearing a cabyar pelt. It's a quick way to earn the enmity of many wilderness creatures, from other cabyars to powerful fey.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 18/45/80 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (piercing), armor (light, medium), skill items (Athletics, Deception, Diplomacy, Nature, Occultism, Stealth)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, charisma, dexterity, energy resistant (vitality), light, mind, mind shield, sensory (low-light vision), spells (Occult: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.K2WpC3FFoHrqX9Q5]{Hypnotize}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.BBvV7qoXGdw09q1C]{Speak with Animals}), strength, throwing, wild, wisdom

description.value: The cabyar can change the colorful patterns of their fur to better blend in with their surroundings, allowing them to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} in areas of dim or bright light even when they don't have cover.
The cabyar can hold their breath for up to 5 minutes before they begin to drown.

Trigger The cabyar is targeted by an attack, and they can see the attacker

Effect The cabyar swiftly flashes the multi-colored patterns of their fur, gaining concealment against the triggering attack.

The cabyar is practiced at shining their light beams directly into their target's eyes. A creature hit by a light beam Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. On a critical failure, or if the creature was already dazzled, it is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v66R7FdOf11l94im]{Friendly} toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.v44P3WUcU1j0115l]{Helpful}. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

You create a cloud of mesmerizing patterns and colors that hovers in the air. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the cloud. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it is inside the cloud when you cast it, when it enters the cloud, when it ends its turn within the cloud, or if it uses a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} or Interact action on the cloud. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by hypnotize doesn't attempt new saves.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud.

Critical Failure The target is fascinated by the cloud. While it remains fascinated, it can't use reactions.

You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

The cabyar twirls around, causing light to dance through its shimmering pelt. Creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save. Once a creature attempts this Will save, it is immune to any cabyar's Entrancing Pelt for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for one round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} and off-guard for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled and off-guard for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.
